errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart, not a stacked bar chart. It shows two bars side-by-side for each category, not stacked on top of each other.
The y-axis scale shown in the figure ranges from 60 to 80, not 0 to 80.
The y-axis does not have any units specified. While it might represent a percentage, stating this as a fact is an assumption.

errors.text_span: 图中所有柱状图都呈现为浅灰色。
errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows two sets of bars with different colors: light gray and a darker gray, as indicated by the legend.

errors.text_span: 图中的每个柱状图由两个部分组成，一个白色区域和一个灰色区域，大小各不相同。
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes the chart as stacked. The chart consists of two separate, side-by-side bars for each category. The colors are also misidentified as 'white' and 'gray' instead of light gray and dark gray.
The chart only has 10 categories or groups of bars on the x-axis, labeled 1 to 10. There is no 11th bar.

The description completely fails to mention that there are two distinct data series being compared ('30个模型结果的均值' and '30个模型的投票结果'). It reads the values as if there is only one bar or one value per category, missing the core purpose of the chart which is to compare these two results.
For category 4, both the light gray bar (approx. 70.5) and the dark gray bar (approx. 75.5) are well above 68.
For category 6, both the light gray bar (approx. 70.5) and the dark gray bar (approx. 75) are well above 64.
For category 8, both the light gray bar (approx. 70.5) and the dark gray bar (approx. 75) are well above 66.
For category 10, both the light gray bar (approx. 70.5) and the dark gray bar (approx. 75) are well above 69.

errors.text_span: 在其中的剩余柱状图中，所有柱状图高度对应于近似值：第3个柱状图为71%，第4个柱状图为68%，第5个柱状图为75%，第6个柱状图为64%，第7个柱状图为73%，第8个柱状图为66%，第9个柱状图为70%，第10个柱状图为69%。
errors.evidence: Because the description fails to recognize the two different bars in each group, it provides a single, ambiguous value for each group. It is unclear which bar is being described, and the values are often inaccurate for both.
